items.title: White House says Trump wants diplomacy with Iran as US reportedly could be ready for military attack
items.title_zh: 白宮稱特朗普希望與伊朗外交，但據報美國可能準備軍事攻擊
items.desc: The White House stated that diplomacy is always Trump's first option regarding Iran, but CBS News reports that the US military could be ready to begin strikes as soon as this weekend. Two aircraft carrier groups are being positioned in the Middle East region.
items.desc_zh: 白宮表示外交始終是特朗普對伊朗的首選，但CBS新聞報導稱美軍可能最早於本週末準備開始打擊。兩個航空母艦戰鬥群正在中東地區部署。

items.title: Russian Offensive Campaign Assessment, February 18, 2026
items.title_zh: 俄羅斯攻勢評估：2026年2月18日
items.desc: Ukrainian, US, and Russian representatives concluded trilateral negotiations in Geneva. Ukraine offered significant concessions including territorial compromises, while Russia signaled it would not be satisfied with just territorial concessions and reiterated commitment to dismantling NATO.
items.desc_zh: 烏克蘭、美國和俄羅斯代表在日內瓦結束了三方談判。烏克蘭提出重大讓步包括領土妥協，而俄羅斯表示僅領土讓步無法滿足，並重申拆解北約的承諾。

items.title: Japan narrowly avoids a technical recession in 2025
items.title_zh: 日本2025年勉強避免技術性衰退
items.desc: Japan's economy showed resilience despite global headwinds, with revised GDP figures indicating the country narrowly escaped a technical recession. The report highlights ongoing challenges for the world's third-largest economy.
items.desc_zh: 儘管全球逆風，日本經濟顯示韌性，修訂後的GDP數據表明該國勉強逃過技術性衰退。報告強調世界第三大經濟體面臨的持續挑戰。

items.title: Bangladesh Nationalist Party wins two-thirds majority in general election
items.title_zh: 孟加拉國民族主義黨在大選中贏得三分之二多數席位
items.desc: Tarique Rahman was sworn in as Bangladesh's new prime minister after his party won two-thirds of parliamentary seats, the first election since Sheikh Hasina was ousted in 2024. The Islamist Jamaat-e-Islami took 68 seats.
items.desc_zh: 塔里克·拉赫曼宣誓就任孟加拉國新總理，其政黨贏得議會三分之二席位，這是自2024年謝赫·哈西娜被推翻以來的首次選舉。伊斯蘭主義政黨Jamaat-e-Islami獲得68個席位。

items.title: South Africa faces water crisis as taps run dry in Johannesburg
items.title_zh: 南非面臨水危機，約翰內斯堡水龍頭枯竭
items.desc: In South Africa, as taps run dry in Johannesburg, Africa's richest city, a tone-deaf remark by a senior politician unleashed fury among residents facing severe water shortages.
items.desc_zh: 在南非，隨著約翰內斯堡（非洲最富裕城市）的水龍頭枯竭，一名高級官員的不當言論引發面臨嚴重水資源短缺的居民憤怒。

items.title: China pledges to step up urban renewal, stabilise housing market in 2026
items.title_zh: 中國承諾2026年加快城市更新，穩定房地產市場
items.desc: China will step up urban renewal and efforts to stabilise its property market in 2026 at the start of its latest Five-Year Plan (2026-2030), according to a readout of a housing policy conference released on Tuesday.
items.desc_zh: 根據週二發布的住房政策會議紀要，中國將在最新的五年規劃（2026-2030）開始之際加快城市更新和穩定房地產市場的努力。

items.title: China braces for record 12.7 million graduates entering tight job market in 2026
items.title_zh: 中國應對2026年創紀錄1270萬畢業生進入緊張就業市場
items.desc: The 2026 cohort will be about 4 per cent larger than the 12.22 million graduates in 2025 – an additional 480,000 young people competing for jobs, according to the Ministry of Education.
items.desc_zh: 據教育部數據，2026年畢業生將比2025年的1222萬增加約4%，即額外48萬年輕人競爭就業崗位。

items.title: Chinese scientists hit breakthrough on 2D semiconductor wafers
items.title_zh: 中國科學家在二維半導體晶圓方面取得突破
items.desc: Chinese researchers have announced a new technique to mass produce 2D material wafers, paving the way for high-performance electronics using a successor to silicon. The team from Southeast University in Nanjing announced the breakthrough.
items.desc_zh: 中國研究人員宣布了一種大規模生產二維材料晶圓的新技術，為使用矽的替代品製造高性能電子產品鋪平道路。南京東南大學團隊宣布了這一突破。

items.title: China's real estate woes worsened with Vanke financial struggles
items.title_zh: 中國房地產困境因萬科財務困境加劇
items.desc: China's real estate woes worsened this year on many fronts, with the latest centering on property giant Vanke's financial struggles. New home sales have nearly halved since Beijing started cracking down on developers' heavy reliance on debt.
items.desc_zh: 中國房地產困境今年在多個方面惡化，最新焦點是房地產巨頭萬科的財務困境。自北京開始打擊開發商過度依賴債務以來，新房銷售幾乎減半。

items.title: Baidu's semiconductor unit Kunlunxin files for Hong Kong listing
items.title_zh: 百度半導體部門崑崙芯申請香港上市
items.desc: Baidu's semiconductor unit Kunlunxin has filed for a Hong Kong IPO amid the AI chip boom in China. JPMorgan analysts forecast that Kunlunxin's chip sales would increase sixfold to 8 billion Chinese yuan in 2026.
items.desc_zh: 百度半導體部門崑崙芯已申請香港IPO，正值中國AI芯片熱潮。摩根大通分析師預測崑崙芯2026年芯片銷售將增長六倍至80億元人民幣。

items.title: Momentum builds: 'bigger' Hong Kong property rebound forecast for 2026
items.title_zh: 勢頭增強：預計2026年香港房地產將大幅反彈
items.desc: Hong Kong's lived-in home prices rose to a 14-month high in October. Financial Secretary Paul Chan Mo-po reduced the stamp duty on homes priced up to HK$4 million to HK$100 from HK$60,000 in his February budget to revive the market.
items.desc_zh: 香港二手住宅價格在10月升至14個月高位。財政司司長陳茂波在2月預算案中將400萬港元以下房屋的印花稅從6萬港元降至100港元以提振市場。

items.title: Hong Kong stocks jump into 2026 with biggest surge since May
items.title_zh: 港股2026年開局大漲，創5月以來最大漲幅
items.desc: Hong Kong stocks started 2026 with their biggest surge since May as investors bet on continued bull run. Investors expect Beijing's 'policy pivot' to continue, with focus on demand-side stimulus and stabilising the housing market.
items.desc_zh: 港股2026年開局創5月以來最大漲幅，投資者押注牛市持續。投資者預計北京的政策轉向將繼續，重點關注需求側刺激和穩定房地產市場。

items.title: Hong Kong residential prices to rise 10 percent this year, says Morgan Stanley
items.title_zh: 摩根士丹利稱今年香港住宅價格將上漲10%
items.desc: Morgan Stanley upgraded Hong Kong's property outlook, forecasting residential property values to climb 10 percent in 2026 after bottoming out last spring, as borrowing costs fell.
items.desc_zh: 摩根士丹利上調香港房地產展望，預測住宅物業價值在去年春季觸底後，2026年將上漲10%，因借貸成本下降。

items.title: Hong Kong's High-Speed Rail Network expands with 16 new destinations
items.title_zh: 香港高鐵網絡擴展，新增16個目的地
items.desc: On January 26, 2026, the High-Speed Rail Hong Kong Section reached a significant milestone with an expansion that transformed its connectivity, adding 16 new destinations.
items.desc_zh: 2026年1月26日，香港高鐵段達到重要里程碑，擴展改變了其連通性，新增16個目的地。

items.title: MTR Corp apologises after chaotic 1.5-hour disruption on Island line
items.title_zh: 港鐵就港島線混亂的1.5小時服務中斷道歉
items.desc: MTR Corporation apologised after items from a maintenance vehicle and damage to track equipment caused a 1.5-hour partial suspension of the Island line, throwing Wednesday's morning rush into chaos.
items.desc_zh: 港鐵公司就維修車輛物品和軌道設備損壞導致港島線部分暫停1.5小時道歉，週三早高峰陷入混亂。

sections.title: 📈 港股關注 - 萬國數據 GDS

items.title: GDS Holdings Q3 2025 EPS dramatically exceeds forecast
items.title_zh: 萬國數據2025年第三季度每股收益大幅超出預期
items.desc: GDS Holdings reported Q3 2025 EPS of 3.21, dramatically exceeding the forecast of -0.465, with revenue increasing 10.2% year-over-year to 2.89 billion USD. The stock showed a modest 1.38% increase despite the significant earnings beat.
items.desc_zh: 萬國數據報告2025年第三季度每股收益為3.21，大幅超出預期的-0.465，收入同比增長10.2%至28.9億美元。儘管盈利大幅超預期，股價僅溫和上漲1.38%。

items.title: GDS Set to Raise $335M From IPO of China Data Centre REIT
items.title_zh: 萬國數據將從中國數據中心REIT IPO籌集3.35億美元
items.desc: At the final offering price of RMB 3.00 per unit, the C-REIT's projected dividend yield for 2026 is 5.2 percent, with its enterprise value representing a multiple of 16.9 times EBITDA.
items.desc_zh: 以每股人民幣3.00元的最終發售價，該C-REIT的2026年預測股息收益率為5.2%，企業價值為EBITDA的16.9倍。

items.title: GDS Holdings' SWOT analysis: data center giant's stock poised for growth
items.title_zh: 萬國數據SWOT分析：數據中心巨頭股票有望增長
items.desc: In a landmark development, GDS Holdings successfully launched its C-REIT, marking a significant milestone. The C-REIT has been well-received by the market, with a valuation of approximately 22.0x 2026E EBITDA.
items.desc_zh: 在具有里程碑意義的發展中，萬國數據成功推出其C-REIT，標誌著重要里程碑。C-REIT受到市場好評，估值約為2026年預期EBITDA的22.0倍。

items.title: GDS Moves to Boost Founder's Voting Power to Meet Chinese Control Requirements
items.title_zh: 萬國數據提升創始人投票權以滿足中國控制要求
items.desc: GDS Holdings announced moves to boost its founder's voting power to meet Chinese control requirements, as regulatory compliance remains a key focus for the data center operator.
items.desc_zh: 萬國數據宣布提升創始人投票權以滿足中國控制要求，因為監管合規仍然是該數據中心運營商的關注重點。

items.title: GDS Holdings Q4 2025 Earnings Report Scheduled for March 25
items.title_zh: 萬國數據2025年第四季度財報定於3月25日發布
items.desc: GDS Holdings will release its next earnings report on March 25, 2026. The EPS (TTM) is currently 6.10. Analysts are watching for continued growth in the data center sector.
items.desc_zh: 萬國數據將於2026年3月25日發布下一季度財報。目前每股收益（TTM）為6.10。分析師正在關注數據中心行業的持續增長。

items.title: Meta and Other Tech Firms Put Restrictions on Use of OpenClaw Over Security Fears
items.title_zh: Meta及其他科技公司因安全擔憂限制使用OpenClaw
items.desc: Tech executives have raised concerns about OpenClaw, with Meta telling employees to keep it off work laptops. Security experts warn the AI agent is unpredictable and could lead to privacy breaches.
items.desc_zh: 科技公司高管對OpenClaw表示擔憂，Meta告訴員工不要在工作筆記本電腦上使用。安全專家警告該AI代理不可預測，可能導致隱私洩露。

items.title: OpenAI and Anthropic's rivalry on display as CEOs avoid holding hands at AI summit
items.title_zh: OpenAI和Anthropic的競爭在AI峰會上顯現，CEO們避免握手
items.desc: Sam Altman and Dario Amodei had an awkward moment at the India AI Impact Summit as they chose not to hold hands during a group photo. Competition intensifies between the AI giants over models and advertising approaches.
items.desc_zh: 薩姆·奧爾特曼和達里奧·阿莫迪在印度AI影響峰會上選擇不握手，出現尷尬時刻。兩家AI巨頭在模型和廣告方法上的競爭加劇。

items.title: Infostealer Steals OpenClaw AI Agent Configuration Files and Gateway Tokens
items.title_zh: 信息竊取程序盜取OpenClaw AI代理配置文件和網關令牌
items.desc: Cybersecurity researchers disclosed they have detected a case of an information stealer infection successfully exfiltrating a victim's OpenClaw configuration environment and gateway tokens.
items.desc_zh: 網絡安全研究人員披露，他們檢測到信息竊取程序感染成功竊取受害者的OpenClaw配置環境和網關令牌的案例。

items.title: Six flaws found hiding in OpenClaw's plumbing
items.title_zh: 在OpenClaw的基礎架構中發現六個漏洞
items.desc: Researchers say an AI-powered code scanner traced untrusted data across layers of OpenClaw, exposing exploitable weaknesses including SSRF, authentication bypass, and path traversal.
items.desc_zh: 研究人員表示，AI驅動的代碼掃描器追蹤了OpenClaw各層的不可信數據，暴露了可利用的漏洞，包括SSRF、身份驗證繞過和路徑遍歷。

items.title: SecureClaw by Adversa AI launches as first OWASP-aligned security plugin for OpenClaw
items.title_zh: Adversa AI推出SecureClaw，首個符合OWASP的OpenClaw安全插件
items.desc: Adversa AI announced the release of SecureClaw, an open-source, OWASP-aligned security platform consisting of plugin and behavioral security skill designed to secure OpenClaw AI agents.
items.desc_zh: Adversa AI宣布發布SecureClaw，這是一個開源的、符合OWASP的安全平台，由插件和行為安全技能組成，旨在保護OpenClaw AI代理。
